info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Consumer Service Brokered Product-spec
info.description: The Brokered Product Specification API enables the creation of brokered product specifications within the consumer services domain. This API allows developers to submit detailed information about new products offered to consumers, facilitating the onboarding of new financial solutions. Typical consumers of this API include developers and teams within banking institutions looking to enhance their service offerings with innovative products. By integrating this functionality, businesses can streamline the introduction of new brokered products, improving customer experience and operational efficiency.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new brokered product within the consumer services. You can provide the necessary details for the product you wish to create, which will then be processed and stored in our system.

requestBody.description: Request body for creating a new brokered product under the consumer services. It should contain all necessary details about the product to be brokered, formatted as a JSON object.
